tasks.spec:
You are a code worker editing the freytag-forge repo. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. Edit files ONLY under the current working directory; NEVER edit anything under /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge directly (you may only run its .venv/bin/python). Do NOT git commit, do NOT git add -A, do NOT touch .git. Write short notes to /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/game-reimagination-phase1-notes/step6-notes.md (create the directory).

OWNED FILES: everything under data/stories/continuity-initiative/ (world.yaml, pacing.yaml, handoffs.yaml, knowledge.yaml, storylet-routes.yaml, storylets.md, plot.md; NEW incidents.yaml and connections.yaml), the new test file tests/test_continuity_1c_incident.py, and any existing test under tests/ that pins 1C behaviour this change legitimately alters (edit such a test only when the old behaviour is deliberately removed by this task, and name each one in the notes). storygame/audit.py only if step 2's note applies (see the AUDIT item). Do NOT edit anything else under storygame/ (the runtime is done and story-agnostic; step 3-5b built it). Do NOT touch tests/fixtures/stories/lighthouse-incident. Never write 1C, freight, or any story id into runtime code.

BACKGROUND (read first, read-only): AGENTS.md; docs/world-model-grounding.md (REQUIRED before declaring any place, thing or group; follow its checklist); docs/narrator-writing-guide.md and docs/player-input-guide.md; .plans/game-reimagination-phase1.md (Step 1-5b results and section 5); .plans/1c-contract-result.md (the accepted design: this task implements it); data/stories/continuity-initiative/ (scene 1C in plot.md lines ~243-330, SL-1C-A/B/C in storylets.md and storylet-routes.yaml, k_sl_1c_* and k_bridge_1c_infiltration in knowledge.yaml, 1C deliveries in handoffs.yaml, security_1c / terminal_sweep_1c / t_1c_2a in pacing.yaml); the working example of every new declaration: tests/fixtures/stories/lighthouse-incident/ (incidents.yaml, connections.yaml, storylets.md, knowledge.yaml, storylet-routes.yaml, pacing.yaml) and tests/test_incident_*.py, tests/test_traversal.py; storygame/story_package/loader.py (_validate_incidents and the connection checks) to learn exactly what the loader requires.

GOAL (step 6): replace scene 1C's terminal-administration chain with the revised transfer-window incident from the contract, on the REAL package. The package must load, and both outcomes, the missed window and the recovery must play through in deterministic tests.

DESIGN (decided; do not redesign, but where this text is silent follow the contract and the lighthouse fixture):
1. Free observation. Keep SL-1C-A R1 (facility_proof) as is. Delete SL-1C-A-R2 and k_sl_1c_a_r2 because the token-at-the-service-entrance action becomes outcome B below; preserve the plot.md sentence about the dry maintenance ascent only if another scene's text or fact depends on it (grep first; say what you found). Keep SL-1C-B (requires facility_proof): R1 asserts captives_confirmed_alive, R2 also michelle_possible_sighting. Rewrite k_sl_1c_b_r1/r2 earn text and action_evidence so they are STUDYING or WATCHING the prisoners and the shaft view only; they must NOT match copying numbers or asking Brandon (those are outcomes). Remove the evidence-gap cost from the general captives_confirmed_alive delivery in handoffs.yaml and delete its sentence 'Time runs out before Kristin can copy the full set of prisoner numbers' from fallback_text. Add cue/relevance only where the existing declarations pattern needs it.
2. Incident. New data/stories/continuity-initiative/incidents.yaml: id i_1c_freight_transfer, scene_id 1C, successor_transition_id t_1c_2a, completes_scene true, observation_knowledge_ids = the two SL-1C-B knowledge ids if the field's meaning in the loader fits, missed_window_event_id transfer_window_1c. REPURPOSE the id SL-1C-C as the shared outcome storylet 'The Transfer Window', activation requiring facility_proof and captives_confirmed_alive, with two realizations: outcome copy_numbers = SL-1C-C-R1 (the player copies the visible prisoner numbers and matches them to the missing-person records): advantages [processing_numbers_copied], costs [], also asserts facility_infiltration_needed; outcome secure_route = SL-1C-C-R2 (the player asks Brandon about the transfer route, or has him open the service entrance with the transit token): advantages [service_level_access_known], costs [evidence_gap_processing_numbers], also asserts facility_infiltration_needed and trust_brandon (Brandon's useful knowledge). Advantage sets must be disjoint, so facility_infiltration_needed is deliberately NEITHER an advantage nor a cost. Delete the old SL-1C-C content (national_detention_network_known, architects_strategy_known) and k_sl_1c_c_r1/r2: per decision 2 the logistics computer and the Charles-and-Rebecca recording leave the 1C path and stay undelivered in Phase 1. Keep the two fact DECLARATIONS (world, knowledge, routes) if the loader allows facts with no producer; otherwise remove them and say so in the notes. Do not add any other 1C fact deliveries.
3. Recovery. New storylet SL-1C-D, 'The Sweep Closes In', recovery_storylet_id SL-1C-D. Its activation requires the missed-window fact transfer_window_missed (new fact). Its realization reuses outcome secure_route: it asserts service_level_access_known, evidence_gap_processing_numbers, facility_infiltration_needed, trust_brandon AND the recovery cost terminal_sweep_closing (an existing declared fact, formerly the turn-7 pressure fact; its text is the sweep reaching the upper level). Brandon leads them through the service entrance while the sweep closes in. It must satisfy every recovery rule the loader enforces.
4. Pressure. Remove pacing events security_1c (turn 3) and terminal_sweep_1c (turn 7) with their facts terminal_security_escalating (and its definitions/used_by lists) and the old terminal_sweep_closing PACING EVENT (the FACT stays as the recovery cost). Add ONE pacing event transfer_window_1c, scene 1C, at_turn 5 (the loader requires it not after min_turns 7), effect transfer_window_missed true, one realization text that shows the transfer line going dark and the last prisoners carried out of view. Keep scene 1C min_turns 7 / nudge / handoff values as they are; step 3 already skips the backstop for incident scenes.
5. Bridge. t_1c_2a keeps trigger facility_infiltration_needed. Re-declare canonical event bridge_1c_infiltration_needed so its activation is all_facts_true [facility_proof, captives_confirmed_alive] with any_of [processing_numbers_copied, service_level_access_known] at_least 1 (so it can never fire unearned); keep k_bridge_1c_infiltration. Replace scene 1C bridge_text for t_1c_2a with ONE neutral line that claims no route and no evidence: Kristin and Brandon withdraw from the terminal to prepare a way inside. Do not mention numbers, the route, the network or the architects. (2A variants keyed to the two advantages are step 7, NOT this task.) Check that SL-2A-B and the 2A path still load and their requires still resolve.
6. World. Per the grounding guide, with explicit placements and kinds: (a) new area processing_line, parent service_level; (b) the captives group (already declared) placed at processing_line in scene 1C (find how the loader places a group in a scene; copy the form the loader and existing packages use) with a short placement text; (c) new item prisoner_number_record, name 'prisoner number record', hidden: true, declared place processing_line, with a world fact processing_numbers_copied whose on_assert moves it to kristin and reveals it (one-way binding, as memory_card_recovered does); (d) observation_shaft must not put Kristin inside the service level at the start (the contract forbids claiming she has entered it): reparent observation_shaft under loading_docks, after grepping that nothing else depends on its old parent; (e) logistics_terminal leaves scene 1C item_ids and item_placements; delete the entity from world.yaml only if nothing else in the package references it, else keep it and say so; (f) keep service_entrance fixed and placed at freight_terminal; (g) any new name that is a common word is scene-specific or uses scoped_aliases, per the leak-scan rule. New facts to declare everywhere the package requires (world facts list, knowledge facts with purpose, storylet-routes fact definitions): processing_numbers_copied, transfer_window_missed.
7. Connection. New data/stories/continuity-initiative/connections.yaml with one connection from freight_terminal to service_level via service_entrance, access_fact_id service_level_access_known, a plain arrival_text that does not mention the network or the architects, shaped exactly like the fixture. It is declared but NOT wired to free-text input in this task (that is step 7). Say so in the notes.
8. Storylets.md and plot.md: update the 1C storylet prose and plot.md scene 1C (beats 1C.2 gets the copy-or-route decision under the moving transfer; 1C.3 and 1C.4 are removed from the 1C path with a one-line comment that they await relocation to a later scene, candidate homes 2C.1 and 3B.2). Keep the existing document format so the package compiler still parses them. Write new prose at a 12th-grade level, plain words, one idea per sentence.
9. AUDIT: storygame/audit.py and any completion-matrix or audit test enumerate storylet-routes.yaml. Run them against the real package. If they need to know about incidents.yaml to pass or stay meaningful, make the smallest change and say so; otherwise leave them.
10. PACKAGE VERSION: find whether the package carries a version, hash or pin that saved games are bound to (grep story_package for version/hash and the PRD). If saves are bound to package content automatically, say so. If a manual version field exists, bump it and say so.

TESTS. New tests/test_continuity_1c_incident.py, deterministic, no network, no billed model, no live worker, each under a few seconds. Follow the style of tests/test_incident_*.py (scripted provider) and write every player command to docs/player-input-guide.md (imperative, first-person possessives such as 'Copy the prisoner numbers.' or 'Ask Brandon about the transfer route.'). Cover at least: (1) the real package loads and declares the incident with two outcomes and the recovery; (2) starting from the 1C entry, free observation asserts the observation facts but not any advantage; (3) outcome copy_numbers: advantages and facility_infiltration_needed asserted, no evidence_gap_processing_numbers, the player enters 2A on that turn before turn 7, processing_numbers_copied moves the record to Kristin; (4) outcome secure_route: service_level_access_known, evidence_gap_processing_numbers and trust_brandon asserted, enters 2A before turn 7; (5) the two outcomes are exclusive; (6) a player who does nothing: transfer_window_missed fires at turn 5, grants no advantage, does NOT enter 2A, and is still in 1C past the old turn-11 deadline; (7) recovery after the missed window completes the scene and asserts terminal_sweep_closing in addition to outcome B's facts, and the recovery cannot fire before the window is missed; (8) save then restore after an outcome keeps the facts; (9) the connection is refused (access_closed) before service_level_access_known and resolves after it. Find the existing tests that pinned the old chain (tests/test_incident_characterization.py step 1 turn-11 backstop test on the real package, scene 1C tests, completion matrix, storylet and knowledge tests) and update ONLY what the deliberate change alters; list each in the notes with why. Never use xfail or skip to hide a failure.

HOW TO RUN: first confirm PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -c "import storygame; print(storygame.__file__)" prints a path inside the cwd. Focused: PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --no-cov tests/test_continuity_1c_incident.py tests/test_incident_*.py tests/test_traversal.py. FULL suite: PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --no-cov -n auto (bare pytest, NOT with '.'). Ruff on the Python files you touch: PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check --fix <files>, then -m ruff format <files>. Do not run uv.

NOTES CONTRACT: step6-notes.md: one line per numbered item 1-10 with file:line and anything surprising; every existing test edited and why; every place the loader forced a deviation from this spec and what you did; a list of any dangling references you found to the removed facts or storylets; and one line on what step 7 (2A variants, free-text wiring of follow_connection, discovery cue lifecycle) must still do. Reply with a short summary.

git add -A -- data storygame tests; bad=$(git status --porcelain | grep -v -E "^[AMD]  (data/stories/continuity-initiative/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+|storygame/audit.py|tests/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+\.py)$" || true); [ -z "$bad" ] || { echo "FAIL stray files:"; echo "$bad"; exit 1; }; git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E "^storygame/(runtime|story_package)/|lighthouse-incident" && { echo FAIL runtime or fixture touched; exit 1; }; OUT=/home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/game-reimagination-phase1-patches; mkdir -p $OUT; git diff --cached > $OUT/step6.patch; [ -s $OUT/step6.patch ] || { echo FAIL empty patch; exit 1; }; [ -f data/stories/continuity-initiative/incidents.yaml ] || { echo FAIL no incidents.yaml; exit 1; }; [ -f data/stories/continuity-initiative/connections.yaml ] || { echo FAIL no connections.yaml; exit 1; }; grep -q SL-1C-D data/stories/continuity-initiative/incidents.yaml || { echo FAIL recovery not declared; exit 1; }; n=$(grep -c "^def test_" tests/test_continuity_1c_incident.py); [ $n -ge 9 ] || { echo "FAIL only $n 1C tests"; exit 1; }; grep -q -E "xfail|pytest.skip|mark.skip" tests/test_continuity_1c_incident.py && { echo FAIL skip-or-xfail; exit 1; }; if grep -n -E "terminal_security_escalating|k_sl_1c_c_r|k_sl_1c_a_r2|SL-1C-A-R2" data/stories/continuity-initiative/*.yaml data/stories/continuity-initiative/*.md; then echo FAIL dangling removed ids; exit 1; fi; PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp $PY -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --no-cov tests/test_continuity_1c_incident.py tests/test_incident_loader.py tests/test_incident_recovery.py tests/test_incident_pressure.py tests/test_traversal.py 2>&1 | tail -25; [ ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -eq 0 ] || { echo FAIL focused tests; exit 1; }; PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp $PY -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --no-cov -n auto 2>&1 | tail -12; [ ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -eq 0 ] || { echo FAIL full suite; exit 1; }; $PY -m ruff check storygame tests && $PY -m ruff format --check storygame tests || exit 1; echo PASS'
